title: U.S. stock futures slip, South Korea's Kospi plunges over 8%: Live updates
summary: S&P 500 futures and South Korean equities are declining amid major corporate earnings announcements and an upcoming Federal Reserve meeting. The market volatility reflects investor concern about macroeconomic conditions and monetary policy decisions.
content: S&P 500 futures drop. Investors are bracing for a big week of megacap earnings and a Federal Reserve meeting.

zh.title: 美国股指期货下跌，韩国KOSPI指数跌幅超8%：实时更新
zh.summary: 在重大企业财报公布和联邦储备委员会即将召开会议的背景下，标普500期货和韩国股市正在下跌。市场波动反映了投资者对宏观经济状况和货币政策决定的担忧。

title: Johnson & Johnson offers up to $5.5bn to settle baby powder lawsuits
summary: Johnson & Johnson is proposing a $5.5 billion settlement to resolve long-standing litigation over talc-based baby powder products allegedly linked to cancer. The deal aims to end multiple lawsuits that have plagued the company for years.
content: The proposed settlement aims to close a years-long legal battle over claims its talcs products cause cancer.

zh.title: 强生公司提议55亿美元和解婴儿爽身粉诉讼
zh.summary: 强生公司提议进行55亿美元的和解，以解决长期存在的关于滑石粉婴儿爽身粉产品涉嫌与癌症相关的诉讼。该协议旨在结束多年来困扰该公司的多项诉讼。

title: Shares of SK Hynix plunge 10% in Seoul as semiconductor selloff deepens
summary: SK Hynix shares fell 10% in Seoul as part of a broader semiconductor industry selloff triggered by weakness in U.S. markets. The decline reflects investor concerns about chip demand and market conditions.
content: South Korean semiconductor shares tumbled on Tuesday, extending a rout in chipmakers after another weak session on Wall Street.

zh.title: 半导体行业抛售加深，SK海力士股价在首尔暴跌10%
zh.summary: SK海力士股价在首尔下跌10%，这是由美国市场疲软引发的更广泛的半导体行业抛售的一部分。这一下跌反映了投资者对芯片需求和市场状况的担忧。

title: U.S. and Korean tech stocks are now tightly linked — and that could be a worry for investors
summary: The U.S. and South Korean tech indices have reached their strongest correlation since 2021 at 0.50, meaning movements in one market increasingly predict the other. This tighter linkage could amplify volatility and reduce diversification benefits for investors.
content: The 60-day correlation between the Kospi and Nasdaq 100 recently climbed to about 0.50, its highest level since 2021, according to data provided by Rayliant.

zh.title: 美国和韩国科技股现已紧密相联——这可能令投资者担忧
zh.summary: 美国和韩国科技指数自2021年以来达到最强关联度0.50，意味着一个市场的波动日益预示另一个市场的走势。这种更紧密的关联可能会放大波动性并降低投资者的分散投资收益。

title: Nvidia’s potential new deal with OpenAI would revive a spooky tech-bubble habit, analyst warns
summary: Reports suggest Nvidia may provide financing support for OpenAI's data center expansion, raising concerns about the circular financing arrangements that preceded the dot-com bubble. Analysts worry this trend could inflate AI valuations unsustainably.
content: Investors are fretting over a report that Nvidia could backstop an OpenAI data-center lease, in what would be the largest such arrangement yet.

zh.title: 英伟达与OpenAI的潜在新协议将复活令人担忧的科技泡沫现象，分析师警告
zh.summary: 报告表明英伟达可能为OpenAI的数据中心扩展提供融资支持，引发了对互联网泡沫前夕循环融资安排的担忧。分析师担心这种趋势可能会不可持续地推高人工智能估值。

title: New technical education routes to be offered at 14 in England
summary: England's government is expanding technical education options for 14-year-olds to include AI and manufacturing, aligning curriculum with local labor market demands. The initiative aims to create more career pathways beyond traditional academic routes.
content: The government wants pupils to take subjects like AI and manufacturing which are linked to local jobs.

zh.title: 英国14岁学生开设新的技术教育课程
zh.summary: 英国政府正在扩大14岁学生的技术教育选项，纳入人工智能和制造业，使课程与当地劳动力市场需求相一致。该举措旨在创造超越传统学术路线的更多职业途径。
